source_text: Csp is a non-dimensional parameter taking account of the spindle arm Cfex is a non-dimensional parameter taking account of the reduction of the blade failure force at the location of the maximum spindle torque. If Cspex is below 0.3, a value of 0.3 shall to be used for Cspex. CLE0.8 is the leading edge portion of the chord length at 0.8R CTE0.8 is the trailing edge portion of the chord length at 0.8R.
